messages:
lisa-sales: Customer (BigBank) request: POC where control plane is pinned to EU, inference runs inside their Canada on-prem cluster, BYO-KMS (maybe HSM), and strict "no external egress" for request payloads. They want a pricing delta and a short ops onboarding checklist. Can we confirm?

alex-eng: Feasible using Redwood Private with a customer-managed data plane. Key constraints: if model weights must never leave their network we ship the runtime as an on-prem artifact and avoid pulling weights to the control plane. Telemetry/heartbeats are optional but if disabled, debugging gets harder.

maria-privacy: @lisa-sales we need the full sub-processor list and whether they require HSM-backed keys. If HSM required, that triggers additional validation and procurement. Also clarify whether logs/metrics are permitted to flow to the EU control plane or must be suppressed.

jon-sre: Network/cert notes: control-plane signaling can be restricted to EU endpoints, data plane stays in CA. For mutual TLS we need client certs on the onprem agent and a cert rotation plan. Proposed routing policy snippet: 

```yaml
routing_policy:
  data_plane: onprem: ca-central1
  control_plane: eu-west1
  failover: 
    - eu-west1 # only with explicit customer consent
  egress_restrictions: true
```

jon-sre: Ops estimate: 2-3 engineer days to wire cert rotation, monitoring integration, and SRE runbook. If we need an airgapped installer, add 4-5 days.

lisa-sales: Pricing (initial ballpark): what should I put in the SOW? One-time packaging, BYOK integration, monthly private fee?

alex-eng: Rough numbers (preliminary):
- Dedicated Private seat: +$6,000/mo
- One-time on-prem packaging / airgap support: $30,000
- BYO-KMS integration: $8,000 (HSM add-on: +$12,000)
- Ops handoff & runbook: $5,000
Est. first-month uplift: ~$43k with standard BYOK, ~$55k if HSM required. Recurring: +$6k/mo.

sam-account: tagging finance for SOW conversion and tax checks for Canada.

maria-privacy: Security QA timeline: sub-processor list + KMS flow diagrams in ~72 hours. If they request "no telemetry" mode, tell them it reduces our ability to troubleshoot; we can offer a minimal health heartbeat only.

lisa-sales: Action items: 1) @alex-eng confirm whether model weights can be fully on-prem or small metadata must be present on control plane (due EOD). 2) @maria-privacy produce sub-processor + KMS flow (72h). 3) @jon-sre provide cert rotation plan and ops ETA (3d). 4) @sam-account draft SOW lines. I'll schedule a decision call with customer tomorrow. :eyes: 

deploy-bot: INF-2024 created: "bigbank-eu-controlplane-ca-onprem-byo-kms" 1 assignees: alex-eng, jon-sre 1 due: 3d.

alex-eng: Also note: if they want continuous model updates, suggest signed artifact transfer (SFTP + signed manifest) or a secure package push via their CI. I'll add transfer flow to INF-2024.

lisa-sales: Great. I'll follow up with the customer and share the checklist before the call. :+1:
